title: Check how your workflows are performing
blurb: See weekly enrolments for the last 7 weeks and spot a trigger that has stopped firing.

steps.title: Open the Overview
steps.body: The Overview opens from here rather than a tab at the top. If you're not on it yet, click **Take me there**.

steps.title: Read the trend
steps.body: Look at enrolments week by week across the last 7 weeks. A dip usually means fewer leads came in, or a trigger stopped firing.

steps.title: Act on it
steps.body: If enrolments drop, open the workflow behind that lead source and check its trigger and filters. **Troubleshoot with execution logs** in the Guide shows you how.
